name: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited

facts.business: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited operates a hotel on land leased from the Airports Authority of India.
key_risks: Cross Subsidy Surcharge (CSS) demand from TGSPDCL pending before Telangana High Court
Litigation with Percept Advertising Limited - appeal dismissed for non-prosecution, restoration petition pending
Carrying value of right-of-use asset and lease liability measurement under Ind AS 116 with impairment indicators due to losses
Contingent liabilities including bank guarantees to AAI and duty liability under EPCG scheme
facts.related_party_note: Related parties include Key Managerial Personnel (Managing Director, Whole Time Director, CFO, Company Secretary), Non-whole-time and Independent Directors, and relatives of KMP/Directors. Transactions include remuneration to KMP and sitting fees to directors.
